data.title: 在原七海 · 早餐快好了
data.description: 锅里的汤快好了，七海把火调小，转身去拿碗。桌上已经摆好了筷子，只等最后一道菜。
data.action: reaching for a bowl beside the stove
data.promptProse: In a bright, airy kitchen, Nanami reaches for a ceramic bowl beside the stove while a pot of soup gently simmers, releasing a soft trail of steam. Crisp morning light streams through the kitchen window, highlighting the organized jars on the counter and the neat arrangement of breakfast essentials.
